title: Spyglass: Officially Launched
summary: We are thrilled to announce that Spyglass has officially launched, bringing powerful new capabilities to enhance your productivity and insights.

title: Effortless File Control in Your Editor
summary: Enjoy unparalleled control over your content with new editor features that let you effortlessly manage, upload, and tailor the appearance of all your files.

title: Our Dynamic Product Roadmap is Here!
summary: We're excited to introduce our new public roadmap, offering you a transparent view into our completed features, current priorities, and exciting future plans.

title: Enhanced Checkboxes
summary: We've made checkboxes bigger, easier to click, and draggable, giving you a smoother and more integrated editing experience.

title: Enhanced Real-time Collaboration
summary: Experience a new level of teamwork with our upgraded editor, designed to make real-time collaboration smoother, clearer, and more intuitive for everyone.

title: Seamless Collaboration & Discovery
summary: Effortlessly find and collaborate on shared ideas and quests with your network, making teamwork more intuitive and efficient.

title: Noeko is Now Open Source!
summary: Noeko's entire codebase is now open source, empowering our community with full transparency, greater control, and new opportunities to directly shape the future of the project.

title: Worldwide Language Support
summary: Soon, Noeko will speak your language, offering comprehensive international support to connect users around the globe.

title: Stunning New Themes & Visual Upgrades
summary: Prepare for a stunning visual refresh as we meticulously refine our existing themes and introduce an exciting collection of brand new, diverse options to personalize your experience.

title: Enhanced Constellation View
summary: We are transforming the Constellation view into a dynamic hub for your knowledge exploration and workflow initiation with powerful new filtering and sharing capabilities.

title: Smart Search and Curated Collections
summary: Empower your knowledge discovery with enhanced search filters, dynamic sorting, and the ability to save your precise search results as personalized collections.

title: Dynamic Note Previews
summary: Get a clearer view of your linked content with new display modes that make navigating your notes seamless and intuitive.

title: Noeko's Official Launch: Flexible Hosting & Powerful Plans
summary: Prepare for Noeko's official launch, bringing you the flexibility to self-host or utilize our convenient cloud-based solutions with powerful plans tailored for every user.

title: Enhanced Time-Sensitive Welcome
summary: We're ensuring your homepage greetings always accurately reflect the time of day, providing a more personalized and timely welcome.

title: Streamlined Tag Actions
summary: Take control of your content organization with new streamlined actions, allowing you to easily unapply tags, delete items, and view details directly from any tag list.

title: Unlock More Content Types
summary: Effortlessly bring in information from a wider variety of sources, including videos, websites, and text files, to enrich your knowledge base.
